title: [Request] Add Support for NVIDIA NIM API Platform Integration
body:
### 🥰 Problem Description  
NVIDIA NIM APIs provides a hosted service (`build.nvidia.com`) for deploying open-source models on high-performance NVIDIA GPUs, enabling developers to leverage optimized inference endpoints via APIs. Currently, LobeChat supports multiple inference providers but lacks integration with NVIDIA NIM.  

Adding NIM APIs support would allow users to:  
1. Deploy models efficiently on NVIDIA-optimized infrastructure  
2. Access popular open-source models (e.g., Llama 3, Mistral, DeepSeek-R1) via NIM's managed service  
3. Reduce self-hosting costs/complexity for GPU-based inference  

### 🧐 Suggested Implementation  
1. Add "NVIDIA NIM" provider option in model settings  
2. Configuration fields:  
   - `API Key` (NVIDIA API key)  
   - `Endpoint URL` (NIM deployment endpoint)  
   - `Model List` (auto-populate available models)  

### 📝 Note: DeepSeek-R1 Thinking Protocal Handling
The NIM-deployed DeepSeek-R1 model directly outputs `<think>` formatting blocks in the responses field. These special markers need post-processing adaptation in LobeChat.

### 📄 References

- [NVIDIA NIM LLM APIs Reference](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/llm-apis)
- [NVIDIA NIM deepseek-r1 Reference](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/deepseek-ai-deepseek-r1)
